description: This file defines the TaskContext class and companion object in Apache Spark, providing contextual information and lifecycle management for Spark tasks, including task status, listeners, resource management, and failure handling.

classes.name: TaskContext
classes.description: Abstract class representing the context of a Spark task, providing methods for status checks, listener management, resource handling, and failure management.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the currently active TaskContext.

methods.name: getPartitionId
methods.description: Returns the partition ID of the currently active TaskContext, or 0 if none.

methods.name: withTaskContext
methods.description: Sets a given TaskContext for the duration of a code block.

methods.name: addTaskCompletionListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to be executed upon task completion.

methods.name: addTaskFailureListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to be executed upon task failure.

methods.name: runTaskWithListeners
methods.description: Executes a task with failure and completion listeners triggered appropriately.

methods.name: stageId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the stage this task belongs to.

methods.name: stageAttemptNumber
methods.description: Returns the attempt number of the stage.

methods.name: partitionId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the RDD partition computed by this task.

methods.name: numPartitions
methods.description: Returns the total number of partitions in the stage.

methods.name: attemptNumber
methods.description: Returns the attempt number of this task.

methods.name: taskAttemptId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for this task attempt.

methods.name: getLocalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a local property set upstream in the driver.

methods.name: cpus
methods.description: Returns the number of CPUs allocated to the task.

methods.name: resources
methods.description: Returns a map of resources allocated to the task.

methods.name: resourcesJMap
methods.description: Returns a Java Map of resources allocated to the task.

methods.name: taskMetrics
methods.description: Returns the metrics associated with the task.

methods.name: getMetricsSources
methods.description: Returns metrics sources associated with the task.

methods.name: killTaskIfInterrupted
methods.description: Throws an exception if the task has been interrupted.

methods.name: getKillReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for task interruption, if any.

methods.name: taskMemoryManager
methods.description: Returns the memory manager for the task.

methods.name: registerAccumulator
methods.description: Registers an accumulator with the task.

methods.name: setFetchFailed
methods.description: Records a fetch failure for the task.

methods.name: markInterrupted
methods.description: Marks the task as interrupted with a reason.

methods.name: markTaskFailed
methods.description: Marks the task as failed with an error.

methods.name: markTaskCompleted
methods.description: Marks the task as completed, optionally with an error.

methods.name: fetchFailed
methods.description: Returns the fetch failure exception, if any.

methods.name: getLocalProperties
methods.description: Returns local properties set upstream.

methods.name: interruptible
methods.description: Indicates if the task can be interrupted.

methods.name: pendingInterrupt
methods.description: Prepares to interrupt the task after resource creation.

methods.name: createResourceUninterruptibly
methods.description: Creates a resource in an uninterruptible manner.
